subject: Private Offer: DataOps hybrid Azure+GCP pricing & partner margin
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@dataops.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.io
Date: 2026-01-15T09:03:00-05:00
Subject: Private offer request — Azure + GCP hybrid usage (partner margin question)

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week. DataOps is moving quickly — we have customers in EU/UK that need a hybrid pricing option across Azure and GCP. Our channel partner CloudBridge will resell ops and professional services; they expect a visible reseller margin passed through on invoices.

Can Redwood do a private offer (Azure) and equivalent pricing (GCP listing or reseller invoice) that:
- Supports commit bands (250k, 500k, 1M ARR) with escalating discounts
- Passes a reseller margin to CloudBridge on committed ARR (they're asking for 15%)
- Provides overage crediting for burst months (so our customers have protection)
- Includes an onboarding / first-month credit for CloudBridge enablement

Also please flag any marketplace limitations (VAT, gross vs net listing) for EU customers. We're on a tight timeline for a contract with a healthcare prospect — procurement@dataops.co is on this thread.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Alvarez
Head of Platforms | DataOps Co.

Attachment: DataOps_requirements_summary.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@dataops.co>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, partners@cloudbridge.io
Date: 2026-01-16T10:12:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — Azure + GCP hybrid usage (partner margin question)

Marta — great to connect. I pulled together an initial struct we can operationalize quickly. High level:

1) Pricing model suggestion
- Committed bands: 250k / 500k / 1M ARR (list price tiers)
- Customer-facing discount off list per band (e.g., 20%/30%/40%)
- Reseller margin (pass-through) on committed revenue: 15% of committed ARR paid to CloudBridge via a separate partner invoice line item (not an additional discount to the customer)

2) Overage & credits
- Overage protection: monthly burst credit equal to 10% of committed monthly allowance; additional usage billed at overage rate with a retroactive credit applied if annual commit is met
- Onboarding credit: one-time $15k enablement credit applied to first invoice to cover CloudBridge enablement work

3) Operational notes
- Azure private offer supports line-item partner pass-through if CloudBridge is a registered reseller. For GCP we recommend a matched reseller invoice (since GCP Marketplace handles partner margins differently).
- EU VAT: list prices must be VAT-exclusive; invoicing will need the billing address to determine VAT treatment.

I've attached a draft private offer doc and a SKU mapping to speed quoting. If this structure is acceptable I'll loop in Legal for the reseller uplift clause and Revenue Ops to confirm invoicing flow.

Next steps:
- Marta / procurement: confirm target commit band and preferred start date
- Internal: Irene to validate marketplace constraints; Ben on billing flow; I'll own partner communications

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: DataOps_PrivateOffer_Draft_v1.pdf; Azure_GCP_SKU_mapping.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Alvarez <marta@dataops.co>, partners@cloudbridge.io
Date: 2026-01-17T08:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — Azure + GCP hybrid usage (partner margin question)

Logan — quick ops note (copying Marta for transparency).

- Azure private offers: Marketplace requires partner pass-through to be handled via partner billing relationships. The marketplace platform fee and reseller registration status typically reduce net margin available; recommending we model 10% available for Azure private offers (not the full 15) unless we absorb the delta as a promotional concession.
- GCP: partner uplift usually handled outside the GCP Marketplace listing (partner issues invoice to customer or receives a percentage from DataOps). If CloudBridge wants a visible 15% line, legal will need a clause for reseller revenue share and a flow for tax handling.
- In EU/UK: we must confirm VAT treatment before finalizing list prices; Revenue Ops will need billed entity and tax ID.

Action items for internal:
- Ben: can you confirm whether we can do a one-time onboarding credit from Redwood rather than rolling it into the list price? Also confirm whether partner invoices are supported via our billing provider for the EU region.
- Legal: Please expedite review of a short reseller uplift addendum (6-month temporary uplift is worth discussing).

Irene
Principal, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Marta Alvarez <marta@dataops.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@dataops.co
Date: 2026-01-19T14:21:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — Azure + GCP hybrid usage (partner margin question)

Thanks, Logan and Irene. A few follow-ups from procurement and our partner team: 

- CloudBridge says 15% is their target. They can accept 10% for Azure if there is a temporary uplift (additional 5%) for the first 6 months to cover enablement. Can Redwood commit to a temporary promotional uplift that phases out after 6 months?
- Procurement asks for a sample invoice flow showing where the reseller line would appear and a draft PO template we can use.
- Can Redwood confirm whether onboarding credit can be treated as a Redwood invoice credit (not a discount on list price)? That matters for our AR reconciliation.

If you can send a revised private offer that includes a 6-month promotional uplift flow and sample invoice, we can escalate to our legal and procurement and move to signature next week.

Best,
Marta

Attachment: procurement_requirements.xlsx (xls stub)
